snippet.title: Miniclip: Hong Kong Ninja Gameplay
snippet.description:
Another hour long flash game once again. Similar to Final Fight, Streets of Rage, and one other Miniclip flash game I uploaded way back, Hong Kong Ninja is a flash game where you play and take on various ninja of the same styles as well as other bad guys in the way. Other than the gameplay being long and unusual, who remembers this game?

Platform:
Flashpoint Archive - https://flashpointarchive.org/
